title: Plural 11: Irregular Plurals Mixed Review
description: A consolidation of all the irregular plural families from lessons 9 and 10: stress-shifted -а́, the -ья family, де́ти / лю́ди, plural-only nouns, and the -анин / -янин pattern. No new material - sort by family and produce the right form in context across the six cases.
descriptionRussian: Повторение всех неправильных семей множественного числа из уроков 9 и 10: ударное -а́, группа на -ья, де́ти / лю́ди, слова только во множественном и модель -анин / -янин. Ничего нового - определяйте семью и образуйте нужную форму в контексте во всех шести падежах.
intro: The irregular half of the plural, all five families in one place. None of them can be derived and all of them are high-frequency, which is the usual Russian bargain: the words that break the rules are the words you cannot avoid. Learn them as whole forms across the cases rather than as exceptions to something.
rules: Stress-shifted -а́: nominative plural in stressed -а́ (дома́, города́, учителя́); the other cases keep this stem with regular endings.
The -ья family: plural on a soft -ья stem (бра́тья, друзья́, сту́лья); genitive plural -ьев (бра́тьев) or -ей (друзе́й).
Completely different words: ребёнок → де́ти, челове́к → лю́ди; the instrumental is the contracted детьми́ / людьми́.
Plural-only nouns: no singular (часы́, де́ньги, очки́, но́жницы); the genitive plural is memorised (часо́в, де́нег, очко́в, но́жниц).
The -анин / -янин pattern: drop -ин, add -е in the plural (граждани́н → гра́ждане); the genitive plural is zero (гра́ждан, англича́н).
examples: В го́роде стро́ят но́вые дома́. (They are building new houses in the city.) Stress-shifted -а́.
Ма́ша гуля́ет с друзья́ми. (Masha is out with her friends.) The -ья family, instrumental друзья́ми.
В па́рке мно́го дете́й. (There are many children in the park.) Different word: де́ти → дете́й.
У меня́ нет де́нег. (I have no money.) Plural-only де́ньги → де́нег.
На пло́щади мно́го англича́н. (There are many English people in the square.) -анин pattern, zero gen pl.

items.promptEnglish: In the forest Masha saw tall trees.
items.hint: Дерево is in the -ья family. What is its nominative plural?
items.explanation: Де́рево builds its plural on the soft -ья stem: дере́вья (the -ья family). The regular forms де́ревы / дере́вы do not exist. The inanimate accusative plural equals the nominative, so высо́кие дере́вья is right.

items.promptEnglish: Masha talked with people for a long time.
items.hint: С + instrumental. Люди takes the contracted -ьми.
items.explanation: Лю́ди (the plural of челове́к) takes the contracted archaic instrumental -ьми: людьми́. Людя́ми with the regular -ями is not used, and челове́ками is wrong because челове́к has no regular plural of its own.

items.promptEnglish: Sharp scissors are lying on the table.
items.hint: Subject role = nominative plural. Но́жницы is a plural-only noun.
items.explanation: Но́жницы is a plural-only noun, and as the subject it stands in the nominative plural но́жницы. Но́жниц is the genitive plural (па́ра но́жниц), and но́жницев is an invented masculine ending.

items.promptEnglish: Masha is reading a book about Russian cities.
items.hint: О + prepositional plural. Город is stress-shifted; the other cases keep that stem.
items.explanation: Го́род takes the stress-shifted plural stem (nom города́), and the prepositional plural sits on the same stem: о города́х. Го́родах with the singular stress is non-standard; городо́в is the genitive plural.

items.promptEnglish: Many peasants live in our village.
items.hint: Много + gen pl. Крестья́нин drops -ин; the gen pl is zero.
items.explanation: Крестья́нин drops the -ин syllable in the plural (крестья́не) and takes a zero genitive plural: мно́го крестья́н. Крестья́не is the nominative plural; крестья́нинов and крестья́нов keep singular material the plural has dropped.

items.promptEnglish: The parents were proud of their sons.
items.hint: Гордиться + instrumental. Сын is in the -ья family.
items.explanation: Сын is in the -ья family: the plural is сыновья́, and the instrumental plural is сыновья́ми (soft stem + regular -ями). Сына́ми / сынами́ are not real forms.

errorCorrection.explanation: Дети takes the contracted archaic instrumental -ьми, not the regular -ями: со свои́ми детьми́. Де́тями is the trap. The closed -ьми list is exactly three: детьми́, людьми́, лошадьми́.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Good teachers work at the school.
errorCorrection.explanation: Учи́тель takes the stress-shifted nominative plural учителя́, not the regular soft -и (учи́тели). Учителе́й is the genitive plural (мно́го учителе́й), wrong for a subject. Note that учи́тель is irregular only in the nominative plural; its other cases (учителе́й, учителя́м) are regular soft -ь forms.

errorCorrection.sentence: У меня́ в карма́не нет де́ньг.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I have no money in my pocket.
errorCorrection.explanation: Де́ньги is a plural-only noun; after нет it takes the genitive plural, which inserts a fleeting vowel to break the cluster: де́нег. Де́ньг is the unpronounceable bare-cluster trap.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There were many English people on the street.
errorCorrection.explanation: Мно́го triggers the genitive plural. Англича́нин drops -ин in the plural (англича́не) and takes a zero genitive plural: англича́н. Англича́не is the nominative plural (wrong after мно́го); англича́нов keeps a singular stem the plural has dropped.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Big ships are standing in the harbour.
minimalPairs.explanation: This item checks the regular pattern against the irregular ones: кора́бль is a regular soft -ь masculine, so the nominative plural is корабли́ (regular -и), NOT a stress-shifted -а́ form. Not every masculine joins Family 1; корабля́ would be the genitive singular.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha often plays with the children.
minimalPairs.explanation: Дети takes the contracted -ьми in the instrumental, not the regular -ями. The closed list is just three nouns: детьми́, людьми́, лошадьми́.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton writes letters to his brothers.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Письма + dative recipient; брат is -ья family, dative plural братьям.

sentenceBuilding.translation: There are beautiful houses in this city.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Дом is stress-shifted: the nominative plural is дома.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Olga left her glasses at home.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Очки is plural-only and inanimate; the accusative equals the nominative.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Thousands of citizens gathered in the square.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Тысячи forces the genitive plural; гражданин drops -ин to the zero ending граждан.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each noun into its irregular plural family.

patternRecognition.question: Which family does сту́лья belong to?
patternRecognition.explanation: Стул → сту́лья builds the plural on a soft -ья stem. Its genitive plural is сту́льев (the -ьев subset, with бра́тья and дере́вья).

patternRecognition.question: Which family does гра́ждане belong to?
patternRecognition.explanation: Граждани́н drops the -ин syllable in the plural and adds -е: гра́ждане. Its genitive plural is the zero form гра́ждан.

patternRecognition.question: What kind of noun is кани́кулы?
patternRecognition.explanation: Кани́кулы ('school holidays') exists only in the plural; there is no singular. Its genitive plural is the memorised кани́кул (по́сле кани́кул).

patternRecognition.question: Which family does доктора́ (here genitive докторо́в) belong to?
patternRecognition.explanation: До́ктор is on the stress-shifted list: the nominative plural is доктора́. The genitive plural sits on the same stem with the regular -ов ending: докторо́в.

reviewVocab.definition: the stress-shifted nominative plural family (дома́, города́, учителя́, профессора́, доктора́, поезда́). The other cases keep this stem with regular endings.
reviewVocab.example: В городе строят дома́. Маша читает о города́х.

reviewVocab.definition: the soft -ья plurals (бра́тья, друзья́, сту́лья) with gen pl -ьев or -ей; and the different words де́ти / лю́ди with the contracted instrumental детьми́ / людьми́.
reviewVocab.example: Антон гуляет с друзьями. Маша играет с детьми.

reviewVocab.definition: plural-only nouns (часы́, де́ньги, очки́) with a memorised gen pl, and the -анин / -янин pattern that drops -ин and takes a zero gen pl (гра́ждане → гра́ждан).
reviewVocab.example: У меня нет денег. На площади много граждан.
